NotFound.description: The address you opened is not available.

Auth.secretHint: Owners use a password, employees use a 6-digit PIN.
Auth.errorLocked: Account temporarily locked. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
Auth.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts from this device. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
Auth.changePinSubtitle: For security, replace your initial PIN before continuing.

Showcase.title: UI Components
Showcase.subtitle: Preview of the base components for the active palette and theme.
Showcase.dialogDescription: This action will be recorded in the audit log.
Showcase.sheetDescription: On mobile devices the cart appears as a bottom sheet.

Employees.title: Employees
Employees.subtitle: Manage employee accounts and their roles.
Employees.name: Name
Employees.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Cannot be changed.
Employees.initialPinHint: 6 digits. The employee must change it at first sign-in.
Employees.emptyDescription: Add employees so they can sign in with a PIN.
Employees.noRoles: There is no active role to choose yet. Create a role first.
Employees.errorOwnerProtected: The owner account cannot be changed here.
Employees.errorSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account.
Employees.ownerNote: The owner account has full access and cannot be changed or deactivated.
Employees.resetPinDescription: Set a temporary PIN. The employee is signed out everywhere and must change the PIN at next sign-in.
Employees.pinReset: PIN reset. Give the temporary PIN to the employee.
Employees.statusActive: This account is active and can sign in.
Employees.statusInactive: This account is inactive and cannot sign in.
Employees.deactivateDescription: The employee cannot sign in and all sessions end. Their history is kept.
Employees.activateDescription: The employee can sign in again with their PIN.

Roles.title: Roles
Roles.subtitle: Set the permissions of each role.
Roles.name: Role name
Roles.systemNote: The Owner role has every permission and cannot be changed.
Roles.errorNameTaken: This role name is already taken.
Roles.errorInUse: Active employees still use this role. Move them to another role first.
Roles.statusActive: This role is active and can be assigned to employees.
Roles.statusInactive: This role is inactive and grants no access.
Roles.deactivateDescription: Inactive roles cannot be assigned to employees.
Roles.activateDescription: The role can be assigned to employees again.

Audit.title: Audit Log
Audit.subtitle: Trail of every important activity. Entries cannot be changed or deleted.

Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: Store details, taxes and operating rules.
Settings.readOnly: You can only view these settings.
Settings.brandNote: App name, store name, logo and appearance are set by the developer in src/config/app.config.ts.
Settings.npwpHint: 16 digits. Printed on invoices when VAT is enabled.
Settings.priceIncludesTaxHint: When unchecked, VAT is added on top of prices (exclusive).
Settings.invoicePrefixHint: Uppercase letters, digits or dashes; up to 10 characters.
Settings.allowNegativeStockHint: Sales go through even when stock is insufficient.
Settings.heldOrderHoursHint: Online orders without a status change for this long are flagged as held.
Settings.sessionIdleMinutesHint: Users are signed out after being inactive this long (15–1440).
Settings.noBankAccountsDescription: Add an account so cashiers can accept transfers.
Settings.noMarketplacesDescription: Add the marketplaces where the store receives online orders.
Settings.name: Name
Settings.statusInactive: Inactive and not offered at checkout.
Settings.deactivateDescription: Past records are kept, but it can no longer be chosen at checkout.
Settings.activateDescription: It can be chosen at checkout again.

Catalog.title: Products
Catalog.subtitle: Manage products, prices and categories.
Catalog.name: Product name
Catalog.costHint: Visible only to roles allowed to see cost prices.
Catalog.skuHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. Unique across all products.
Catalog.minStockHint: The low-stock marker appears at or below this number.
Catalog.trackStockHint: Turn off for services or menu items without counted stock.
Catalog.emptyDescription: Add products so they can be sold at the cashier.
Catalog.noResultsDescription: Change the search term or filters.
Catalog.noCategoriesDescription: Every product belongs to one category.
Catalog.stockNote: Current stock {stock}. Stock changes go through the Stock menu so they are recorded.
Catalog.statusActiveNote: The product is active and shown at the cashier.
Catalog.statusInactiveNote: The product is inactive and hidden at the cashier.
Catalog.deactivateDescription: The product is hidden at the cashier. Its sales history is kept.
Catalog.activateDescription: The product is shown at the cashier again.
Catalog.categoriesEmptyDescription: Categories group products at the cashier and in reports.
Catalog.deleteCategoryDescription: A deleted category cannot be restored.
Catalog.categoryInUseNote: This category has {count} products and cannot be deleted.
Catalog.errorNameTaken: This category name is already taken.
Catalog.errorSkuTaken: Another product already uses this SKU.
Catalog.errorCategoryInUse: The category still has products and cannot be deleted.
